ai_summary: Alicon Castalloy Limited achieved record Q1 FY2027 revenue with consolidated sales up 37.7% (17.5% volume-adjusted), driven by strong domestic automotive demand and new business wins. However, profitability was significantly challenged by volatile input costs and a temporary slowdown in European operations, resulting in a modest 9.5% EBITDA margin, despite higher net profits year-on-year. The company is actively implementing "Reset, Refocus, Rebuild" strategies, investing Rs. 125 crore in new capacities, and aiming to improve operational efficiency to convert its robust Rs. 8,450 crore order book and 12-15% projected underlying FY27 growth into sustainable margin expansion, as current benefits from cost recovery and new program ramp-ups are largely prospective.
